purpose: Known-answer synthetic cases for joining CityMaker owner-artifact envelopes to exact #500 payload verification report records.
normative_notice: Every artifact, descriptor, report, digest, object reference, owner disposition and scope is synthetic. No fixture contains real or restricted source content.
